name: Error message lexicon: 149 server and mail error messages explained
description: SMTP, DNS, TLS, nginx, PHP, database and Nextcloud errors with cause, checks and fix, in German, English and Italian.
source: Editorial lexicon by Daniele Michelin, written from support practice
